title: Bissell returns to the CIA after his ouster

tellings.quote: In Bissell's case, the rumor was he left work at the CIA on Friday and on Monday he returned because he was too indispensable to certain [music] activities he was involved in.

plain: Richard Bissell, a senior official at the CIA, the US spy agency, was pushed out in 1961, but the rumour is that he left work on a Friday and was back on the Monday because he was too indispensable to certain activities. Michels repeats this as a rumour, without naming a source, as a hint that Bissell was tied to secret work that could not do without him.
